title: 14 · tripura · One Arrow, Three Cities
lines: Three cities flew through the sky.
One arrow destroyed all of them.
The archer had waited a thousand years to shoot it.
Three demon brothers asked for a boon.
Give us three cities that fly. Gold, silver and iron.
"Give us three cities that fly. Gold, silver and iron.
Everything ends, said Brahma. Choose how.
Only if one arrow hits all three at once.
"Only if one arrow hits all three at once.
And they line up for one moment, every thousand years.
And they line up for one moment, every thousand years."
And being untouchable made them cruel.
The gods built Shiva a chariot.
The earth was its floor. The sun and moon were its wheels.
Years passed. The gods begged him to shoot.
And when the three cities drifted into one line, for a single breath,
Power is patience that knows its moment. That is sadhana.
